prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a refined museum-object illustration of the real Borobudur monument for the Daily Culture app, using the attached photograph as the structural reference. The result should feel like a carefully made architectural scale model rendered in a quiet design catalog. Isolate the complete temple, removing all people, trees, grass, sky, railings and surrounding landscape. Preserve its recognizable stepped square terraces, relief-lined galleries, stairways, upper circular tiers, bell stupas and central stupa; do not redesign the monument. Camera: slightly elevated three-quarter view, natural perspective without wide-angle distortion, enough elevation to read the sequence of terraces. Materials: faithful subdued charcoal-gray volcanic stone, simplified only in surface noise, crisp architectural edges, softly visible relief texture; no white clay, plastic, gold, glossy finish or toy-like rounding. Lighting: broad soft studio light from upper left, gentle shading, no hard dramatic shadows. Composition: square PNG canvas, complete object centrally placed, 10-14 percent breathing room, a very small soft grounding shadow. Genuinely transparent background with real alpha, no white rectangle, gray matte, checkerboard drawn into the image, horizon line, landscape base, text, labels or watermark. This is an illustrative design study rather than a survey reconstruction. Render only one object image, not a UI or a contact sheet.

Use case: background-extraction with restrained style-transfer. Create a refined museum-object illustration of Michelangelo's actual marble David for the Daily Culture app, using the attached photograph as the identity and geometry reference. Isolate the complete sculpture and its integral small marble footing; remove the museum architecture and large display pedestal. Preserve Michelangelo's exact pose, left hand at the shoulder holding the sling, right hand down, head turned, focused expression, curls, bodily proportions, contrapposto, feet and tree-trunk support. Preserve the historical sculpture's anatomical details without censorship or added clothing. Maintain the recognizable front three-quarter viewpoint of the reference; do not mirror or invent an alternative pose. Treat as a faithful restrained museum render, not a photograph in a room, not cartoon, no exaggerated anatomy, no decorative reconstruction. Materials: soft ivory-white matte marble with quiet gray detail. Lighting: large soft studio light from upper left, gentle form shading, subdued contrast matching a minimal architectural model catalog. Composition: square PNG canvas, full head-to-feet silhouette visible, centered, sculpture approximately 84 percent of canvas height, generous negative space either side, small subtle grounding shadow. Genuinely transparent background with real alpha, no white rectangle, gray matte, checkerboard drawn into the image, text, labels, watermark, scenery or artificial display plinth. Render only the isolated asset, not UI.
